articles.title: Binance France emails announce closure of its users’ accounts on Dec. 31
articles.snippet: Any assets left on the exchange will be charged monthly fees starting on Nov. 29, company says.

articles.title: US sanctions Canadian money-exchange firms over Iran ties
articles.snippet: US also offers as much as $20 million and possible relocation for information about Iran’s nuclear program.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin Moves On From ‘Ultrasound Money,’ Says ETH’s Value Is Stability
articles.snippet: The Ethereum co-founder says ETH's value comes from stability, not fee burns, citing its decentralization, censorship resistance and security.

articles.title: Tom Lee’s Bitmine Adds $20M in Ethereum, Seizing on Vitalik’s 'ETH Is Money' Declaration
articles.snippet: The firm’s stash reached 6.07 million ETH—4.97% of supply and 99% of the way to its “Alchemy of 5%” goal—as chairman Tom Lee called Vitalik Buterin’s “ETH is money” comments a “seismic shift.”

articles.title: Nvidia Board Investigates Jensen Huang After Report He Was Target of Chinese Spy Effort
articles.snippet: Huang told staff he had been "unfaithful" to his wife, as Nvidia shares fell nearly 5% in premarket trading on Monday.
